notes: HOODTToken (src/HOODTToken.sol) is the only contract this launch deploys; contracts is empty. It is a self-contained, fixed-supply ERC-20 named Hood Test with symbol HOODT and 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply, 1,000,000,000 HOODT = 1000000000000000000000000000 minor units, once to msg.sender, the launch factory, and never subtracts any allocation. totalSupply() returns the compile-time constant TOTAL_SUPPLY, so the supply can never grow or be minted again. transfer, approve and transferFrom are plain ERC-20 with no fee, tax, limit, pause, blacklist or freeze; a transfer to the zero address or an approval of the zero spender reverts; an allowance of type(uint256).max is treated as infinite. There is no owner, no admin function, no proxy, no upgradeability, no delegatecall and no selfdestruct, and every parameter is a constant. Because transfers move exactly what they say, the factory's flows (swarm share to the Merkle distributor, 90% seed into the Uniswap v4 pool through the PoolManager, remainder to remainderTo) and trader swaps each way arrive whole. The swarm's 10% is taken by the factory and is not written here. pool.initialPrice is provenance only (IMD minor units per HOODT minor unit with HOODT as currency0); the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply using the deployed currency order.
